evidence: Source review supports a zero for ordinary blank/static/seed-copy/keyword-stuffed/refusing apps, but no weak-app run measured this claim. Render gate requires a newly authored JavaScript loop, Run, two real button clicks, and corresponding preview AND console totals (frozen task/tests/gates/render/judge.toml:23), so a blank page, static seed copy, copied source, dead button, or action refusal should fail. Constraints additionally requires a custom editing surface and a unique newly saved .js record observed from a clean browser context and reloaded fresh server response (frozen task/tests/gates/constraints/judge.toml:23,32); static seed or browser-local mock should fail. tests/scoring.toml:2-11 assigns zero gate mass and functional floor 0.05; tests/tools/score.py:41-48 forces reward 0 when either gate or floor fails, and tests/test.sh:213-224 runs gates before scored. A working alternative using public CDN assets can still pass because neither gate demands same-origin assets. Hashes for these frozen files match manifest.json input_sha256 988cc513c1ccda1eec9563f88f73b3d673b5a7679727d55c68a85c2e7ca7985e (e.g. scoring.toml 95f70d6e06aae5e765b2309d88c444aa36d4cd82763ea2212781b6a99311bbba, score.py 13de2b3885967e22aa13ded3bf33c354e3e741e85be871612c04e996eef5c04e). A narrow mock that implements only the gate flows could pass gates; two 1.0-weight functional rows exceed the 0.05 floor because functional criterion weight totals 30.5, potentially earning visual/polish credit, but this app would actually perform authored Run and clean-context Save and is a partially working product rather than the static/refusing floor case. No raw-evidence-index.json or runtime-evidence.json exists in the run, and preflight.json is structural evidence, not a weak-app judge run. Actual RewardKit behavior and low floor across all named weak submissions remain unmeasured.
